scenario: Discussing a news story with a colleague
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ekontekiswini lezindaba, isicela isifanekiso esingenhlekwane noma umbhalo.
Isethulwa esetshinzwe ukuthetha ngengxoxo noma isiqingatha.
Isazisi esichaza ukuba kukhona umqondo wokuba kunjalo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you see the report about the new public transport plan?
dialogue.translation: Ingabe ubone isifanekiso ngokuhlela kwezimali ezindabeni eziqondile?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I read it. Although the government says it will help, many people are against it.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, ngilifundile. Nakuba umthetho uthi uzosiza, abantu abaninzi bangaxhaxha kulo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the main issue is the cost. It might increase taxes, and that could have a big effect on the economy.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ingxoxo engkhulu ngokusingatha. Mhlawe wandisa iziko, lokho kungaba nompumelelo omkhulu kwebhanga.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Probably, but they say it will create more jobs. I'm not sure what they will decide.
dialogue.translation: Mhlawe, kodwa bathi uzowudonsa imisebenzi emininzi. Angikholwa ngalutho abazokuthatha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but if they cut other services, it will be a problem. The public might be more affected than they think.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, kodwa uma baxhubelela izinkxaso ezinye, kuzoba yingxoxo. Umphakathi mhlawe waphathwa ngaphezulu kunokuba bakholelwa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's wait and see. Although I'm a bit worried, I hope they make a good choice.
dialogue.translation: Makhe siqhubeke ukubona. Nakuba nginesizathu sokuba ngiyeke, ngiyakuthula ukuba bazokuthatha isiqalo esihle.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we can only hope. I'll check the news again tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, singakwazi ukuthula kuphela. Ngizokubuyela ukubona izindaba kusasa.

scenario: Negotiating a minor disagreement
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kusetshenziswa ukudonsa ukuvumelana nombuzo okanye umthombo.
Kusetshenziswa ekufeni komsuka ukuze kubekezeleke indlela yokucabanga.
Ukudonsa ukuba kukhona isikhombisa sokuba into ethile ingase yenzeke.
Kudonsa isikhombiso esisodwa nalokho okudonsiweyo ngaphambili.
Isicabango okanye inhloso yokwenza into ethile.
Ukushintsha into, ukuze kube yisahluko esisha.
Kufanana noma, kodwa kancane kakhulu okwedlula ekusetshenzisweni.
Kudonsa ukungabi noma ukungasayi into ethile.
Kudonsa ukudla isicabango esiphinga nalokho okudonsiweyo ngaphambili.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I don't agree with your plan to go to the beach, though.
dialogue.translation: Angivumelani nomphango wakho wokuya ebeach, nakhu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we could change the time instead of changing the place.
dialogue.translation: Mhlawumbe singashintsha isikhathi esikhundleni sokushintsha indawo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I'm not sure it's the best matter to discuss right now.
dialogue.translation: Leyo iyisicabango esihle, kodwa anginqubisisi ukuba yisihloko esihle ukudiscussa manje.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perhaps we should just decide together without arguing.
dialogue.translation: Mhlawumbe singathatha isiqotho ngisho futhi ngaphandle kokuxabana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree, but I still think the plan has a problem, though.
dialogue.translation: Ngivumelana, kodwa ngisengithi umphango unequbuka, nakhu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we can try a different plan, perhaps a picnic instead?
dialogue.translation: Mhlawumbe singazama umphango othile, mhlawumbe isikhombiso esikhundleni?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, that could work without any problem. Let's do that, though.
dialogue.translation: Nqoba, lokho kungase kuse benzise ngaphandle kwesikhubeka. Ase singenzile, nakhu.

scenario: Giving feedback on someone's work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Seyinhlosi yokusho ukuthi into ayikwenzekanga kuze kube ngale lamuhla.
Iyeza isifanekiso esiphikisanayo. Inothulela: 'though' isesihlalweni sokuba ikwahlulelwe, kodwa isengenwa lapha njengesibopho esingokwesicelo somthelela.
Iyeza indima yokuba into eyinhlanhla kangakanani.
Iyeza ukuhlela amazwi okuthiwa noma imisamo ukuze akhulise noma akhombise isizingeli.
Isiphumo noma isisombululo somsebenzi noma umsebenzi.
Seyinhlosi yokufakela umbono oyahlanganyela nomo owalapho.
Ukusiza noma ukusekela umuntu noma into.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I’ve read your draft, but I haven’t finished the last section yet.
dialogue.translation: Ngifunde isibhalo sakho, kodwa angisekuzalisile isigaba esisodwa ngakambe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That’s okay. The quality of the beginning is quite good, I think.
dialogue.translation: Kulungile. Ubuchwepheshe bokusasa kuhle kakhulu, ngiyakholelwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree with that, though we need to improve the ending a lot.
dialogue.translation: Ngivumelana naloko, nakhu kudingeka ukuthi sikwendeleze ukuphela kakhulu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, the result is not strong enough. However, your ideas are clear.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, isiphumo asilamnandi kangaki. Nakhu, amazwi akho alula.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. What else should I consider for the final version?
dialogue.translation: Ngiyabonga. Yini okunye engikufelwe ukucabanga ngakho ngenxa yendawo yokuphela?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It’s possible to add more examples, and provide more evidence for your claims.
dialogue.translation: Kuningi ukuze sengeshe izibonelo ezinengi, futhi sikunike imiboniso emininzi ngamazwi akho.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I’ll work on that. Can you support me with the data?
dialogue.translation: Kuhle, ngizokwenza ngakho. Ungasengiyela ngendatshi?

scenario: Explaining a problem to customer service
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I received my order yesterday, but the color is wrong.
dialogue.translation: Sawubona, ngithole umthombo wami izolo, kepha ubala luyephuza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you send me a photo of the item you received?
dialogue.translation: Ngiyaxolisa ukukwazi lokho. Ungathumela isithombe se-intengiso otholile?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll send it right away. Also, I need to return the item and get a refund.
dialogue.translation: Ewe, ngizothuma ngokusheshayo. Ngiyasinga buyisela intengiso futhi thole ukubuyiswa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. We will not charge you for the return. Please check your email for instructions.
dialogue.translation: Ngokunganakuzayo. Asizothi thole imali ngokubuyisela. Sicela uhlole i-imeyili yakho ngokufuphi nezenzo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. How long will I have to wait for the refund?
dialogue.translation: Ngiyabonga. Isikhathi esingisandla kanjani ukuze thole ukubuyiswa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Usually it takes 5–7 days. Please be careful with the return label we provide.
dialogue.translation: Ngokuvamile ithatha usuku 5 kuze kube 7. Sicela ube nobucingeli ngesiga lokubuyisela esisipho.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I'll be careful. Thank you for solving my problem.
dialogue.translation: Kuhle, ngizobe nobucingeli. Ngiyabonga ngokuphatha isiqu mi.

scenario: Talking about ambitions and career goals
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Seyenziwa ukudlulisela izimiso noma iziseko, kakhulu kunokuthi 'get'.
Iqcambisa indlela yokusebenza, hhayi 'indlela yokufunda ekhishilweni'.
Sesekelwe, kodwa kuhlehliswa phambi kwabanye ukuze kugcwalwe inani.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to achieve a high position in my career, but I know it will require a lot of effort.
dialogue.translation: Ngifisa ukuthola indawo ephakeme endleleni yami yokusebenza, kodwa ngiyakwazi ukuthi izodinga amandla amaningi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a great goal. What kind of role would you like to reach in the future?
dialogue.translation: Le yisaza esihle. Ufile ukuthola uphi uhlobo lwesikhundla esizakufikela esizayo?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd love to lead a team someday, but I think I need more experience first.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyakuthanda ukukhokela isibonelo ngelinye ilanga, kodwa ngicabanga ukuthi ngidinga ukubhekana okuningi kuqala.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you can find an opportunity to manage a small project at work.
dialogue.translation: Mhlawumbe ungathola indlela yokudlala umsebenzi omncane emsebenzini.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope so. Success doesn't come overnight, so I'll continue studying and improving my skills.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyakuthanda ukuba kunjalo. Ukuphumelela akufiki ngobusuku, ngakho ngizokwalandela ukufunda nokuphucula imisebenzi yami.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's the right attitude. I'm sure you'll achieve everything you set your mind to.
dialogue.translation: Leyo ingqondo enhle. Ngiyavuma ukuthi uzothola konke okwakhiwe ngengqondo yakho.

scenario: Discussing health habits and lifestyle
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ngosho futhi ngasengithi isigaba, kodwa lapha sisetshenziswa njengomshikashika.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to exercise in the morning, but I don't do it often.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyazama ukusebenza ngengoma, kodwa angikwenzanga ngokubanjwa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's okay. The important thing is to listen to your body and find a routine that works for you.
dialogue.translation: Kulungile. Into engenani yikuba ulalele isilima sakho ufunde indlela ebeka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know. I feel much better when I have more energy during the day.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyakwazi. Ngiyazwa kuhle kakhulu lapha nginekhono eningi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and sleep is a key part of that. Do you sleep at least seven hours?
dialogue.translation: Yebo, futhi ukuzalela yisilinganiso esibalulekile. Uyazalela amahora asixhenxe nassho?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Usually, yes. But my main problem is stress, not sleep.
dialogue.translation: Ngokubanzi, yebo. Kodwa isihloko sami yikuphumuphumuwa, hhayi ukuzalela.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Stress can affect your health a lot. Maybe you need a new habit to relax, like reading or walking.
dialogue.translation: Ukuphumuphumuwa kungakushaya ukuhleka kwakho kakhulu. Mhlawumbe uyadinga isimo esisha ukuze uhlale, njengokufunda noma ukuhamba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, because I want to feel healthier overall.
dialogue.translation: Leyo inganamuhla, ngoba ngifisa ukuzwa ngihleka ngokubanzi.

scenario: Describing a recent trip in detail
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Isetshenziswa ukudlulisela indawo ekupheleni, kakhulu yenhle yobezenzo noma basebenzi.
Ngosazi noma engosazi; lapha kudluliselwa ukubona.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How was your trip to the mountains last weekend?
dialogue.translation: Kwenzeka njani indawo yakho emagabini ngesikhathi esidla ngomzuzu osedlule?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It was quite wonderful, but we arrived later than we expected because of the traffic.
dialogue.translation: Kwabe khona kancane mnandi, kodwa sifikile emva kwesikhathi esibe sisebenzile ngenxa yezixhobo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you stay in a hotel or in a cabin?
dialogue.translation: Wehlala ehhotela noma kwisikhumba?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We stayed in a small cabin with an amazing view of the lake.
dialogue.translation: Sahamba kwisikhumba esincane enobuka obuhle belwandle.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the weather was cloudy, did you still enjoy the experience?
dialogue.translation: Nakuba isimo somoya kwakungesikhathi esihle, wena wabe usithanda ukubona?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we decided to go hiking, and we had a wonderful time, however, the trail was quite steep.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, sasibambe ukuya kwihhamba, futhi sathanda isikhathi esihle, nakuba, indlela yayikakhulu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'm glad you had such a good time. I love to travel to new places too.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyathokoza ukuthi usathanda isikhathi esihle. Nami ngiyathanda ukuya emacansini amasha.

scenario: Talking about environmental issues
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Isetshenziswa ukubikelela ukuthi into engithwala umphumela, ngokubanzi obubi.
Isazisi esibalulekile esetshenziswa ukukhuluma ngokunciphisa impahla yasezindlini.
Isicazulo esithi indima okanye iseqhubekayo esetshenziswa.
Isethunzwa ukubikelela ukuthi into engumnye wedwa, njengoba kunjalo 'single-use' (ukusetshenziswa kwakhezu).
Isethunzwa ukuchaza izinkinga eziqakathekile okanye eziqakathekile.
Iyeza ukuthi isimo silandela. Nalo ngokwezinye iyeza 'ngokwezinye'.
Isethunzwa ukukhuluma ngokuba phansi kwento okanye ukulwa nento.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think plastic waste is a serious problem, but people still use too much of it.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyabona ukuthi amathuluzi amaphlastica ayizingizi ezimbi, kodwa abantu baselula ukusebenzisa kangangabakho.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.yes: I know. A common mistake is using single plastic bags for everything.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyazi. Umphutha othiwa ngokubanzi ukusebenzisa amabhege amaphlastica amanye kuzo zonke izinto.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. That habit can cause a lot of damage to the environment over time.
dialogue.translation: Ngokwanele. Lo mthelela ungasebenzisa ukudonsa okuningi kasezindlini ngosuku lulodwa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what is the best action we can take to reduce our impact?
dialogue.translation: Ngakho-ke, yini indima eyingozi esingayenzela ukunciphisa ukubaluleka kwethu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, using a reusable bottle is a simple step. And it's likely to become a habit quickly.
dialogue.translation: Kuhle, ukusebenzisa ibhotile elingasebenzakala ngokuphindaphindi yiseqhubekayo esilula. Futhi kunesilinganiso sokuba liyophinda luba yisimo ngokushesha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That makes sense. I'm not against small changes, though. Every little bit helps.
dialogue.translation: Lokhu kuhlonipha. Angisephansi kwemiyalo emincane, nakuba. Zonke izinto eziphonyayo ziyasiza.

scenario: Discussing a decision you had to make
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ekontekiswini lokubhalisa, kutsho ukucabanga ngemininingwane leyo engcono leyo engcono.
Kutsho ukucacile noma into ethile kodwa aliyidetafula.
Kusetshenziswa ukutjho isinyathelo esisodwa noma ukubhalisa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I had to choose between two job offers last week.
dialogue.translation: Kwakufuneka ngikhethe phakathi kwemiphumela emibili yokusebenza ivela eluphileni lwam.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a tough decision. What options did you weigh?
dialogue.translation: Le yinto engikhathaza yokubhalisa. Yiziphi izinketho awucabanga ngazo?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I considered the salary and the commute, but the risk of moving to a new city was a big factor.
dialogue.translation: Ngacabanga ngomsholo nokuya emsebenzini, kodwa ingozi yokuhamba ekhaya entsha kwakuyinto enkulu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Were you certain about the outcome of each option?
dialogue.translation: Bekwakho ukucacile ngesiphetho sekhetho elilodwa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Not fully, although I knew the salary was higher in the second job.
dialogue.translation: Kungekuphele, nakuba ngabazi ukuthi umsholo bekungaphezulu kwesibini sesebenza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what did you finally decide?
dialogue.translation: Ngakho, ukubhalisa okwenzile ngokuphakame?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I chose the first job, rather than the second, due to the shorter commute and better work-life balance.
dialogue.translation: Ngikhethe isibani esokuqala, kungekunye lesibili, ngenkinga yokuya emsebenzini enkulu kabanzi nokuphila okuningi kakhulu.

scenario: Explaining why you changed your mind
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kwi-'change your mind' kutsho ukubuyisela kwesiqondiso.
Seyenziwa ukudla isaziso sesikhathi laphakade ubuyisela umbono wakho.
Seyenziwa ukudla isaziso esiphambanisa nalokho okwakholwa ngaphambili.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've changed my mind about the trip to the beach this weekend.
dialogue.translation: Ngibuyisele ingqondo yami mayelana nolahleko oluya ebeach ngesihlabathi esivela.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? Why? You seemed so excited about it before.
dialogue.translation: Ngempela? Kutheni? Wawubonakala unesibindi ngakho ngaphambili.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I realized that the weather forecast is bad, and actually, I have a lot of work to do.
dialogue.translation: Kuhle, ngiqaphele ukuthi umthombo wezulu uyinto enkulu, futhi njengoba, nginekhanda eliningi lokusebenza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But you had a plan to relax and enjoy the sun!
dialogue.translation: Kodwa unecwaningo lokuphumula futhi ukuthokoza kwelanga!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but I realized that it's not possible to finish my project if I go. Since the deadline is Monday, I need to stay home.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, kepha ngiqaphele ukuthi akukho ukungenzeka ukugcina umsebenzi wami uma ngiyahla. Ngenxa yokuthi usuku lokugcina lusuMondi, ngidinga ukuhlala emkhukhwini.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a fact. But you could work in the morning and go later, instead of canceling everything.
dialogue.translation: Leyo into. Kodwa ungasebenzise ngenkathi futhi uye emuva, kunalokho ukucancela konke.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, though I need to see if my friend can support me with the ride. Thanks for the advice!
dialogue.translation: Leyo isiqondiso esihle, nakuba ngidinga ukubona ukuthi umngane wami angisekela ngokuhamba. Ngiyabonga ngenhlakanipho!

scenario: Talking about cultural differences
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I find it interesting how many cultural differences there are between countries.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyakubona ukuthi kukhona izinto ezinengi ezihlobene nokudluliswa phakathi kwezizwe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, even something like greeting can be a custom that changes the behavior of people.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, nokuba yiziphi izinto ezinjengomvuzo zingaba yisiko esiyiguqula ukuziphatha kwabantu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For example, in my culture, it's rude to eat with your hands, but in some places it's completely polite.
dialogue.translation: Ngokwesibonelo, ebudlulisweni bami, ukudla ngesandla kuyinto engcolile, kodwa kwelinye iindlela kuyinto engcolile.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I usually expect people to follow local customs, but I try to respect different ones.
dialogue.translation: Ngokuvamile ngilinda abantu ukuba babe nesiko, kodwa ngizama ukudla izinto ezinye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's good. I think many customs are similar in essence, just expressed differently.
dialogue.translation: Lokho kuhle. Ngicabanga ukuthi izinto ezinengi ziyafana ngokwezinhlobo, kodwa ziyaxoxwa ngendlela eyinye.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, the key is to be open and learn about the differences between us.
dialogue.translation: Ngakho, isikhwele ngukuba sivulekile futhi sifunde ngokudluliswa phakathi kwethu.

scenario: Discussing technology in daily life
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Sebenzisa ukuze qhathanise izikhungo noma abantu.
Bhala noma nika umgomo okufinyelela into.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to connect my new phone to the Wi-Fi, but I can't find the settings.
dialogue.translation: Kudingeka ukuba ngiqhathanise isifuni sami esisha ne-Wi-Fi, kodwa angikwazi ukufumana izilungiselelo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's simple. Just go to the settings app and look for the Wi-Fi option.
dialogue.translation: Kulula. Hama iphuzu lesilungiselelo ubuke ikhebhi le-Wi-Fi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. But I also want to download a new messenger app to message my friends.
dialogue.translation: Oho, ngiyabona. Kodwa ngifuna futhi ukudounloda iphuzu entsha yokuthumela imiyalo kuze ngithumele imiyalo kubangani bam.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's useful, but check the battery first. Downloading can use a lot of energy.
dialogue.translation: Lokhu kuxhumana, kodwa hlola ibhetari kuqala. Ukudounloda kungase kushize amandla amaningi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. And what about the screen? Sometimes it stays on too long.
dialogue.translation: Uphuma. Yini mayelana neskrini? Ngemarhu ayahlala isikhathi eside.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can change that in the settings, too. Also, as a user, you should share your location with friends only if you trust them.
dialogue.translation: Ungahlela kwangaphandle kwesilungiselelo. Nango-ke, njengomsebenzisi, kumele urhane indawo yakho nabangani bakho kuphela uma ubeqinisekile ngabo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks! Now I feel more comfortable using my device online.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyabonga! Manje ngiyajabula ukusebenzisa isikhungo sami ephuzweni.

scenario: At a formal meeting giving your opinion
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Siyathusa ezinye izinto eziqondile ukuze sikhombise ukubuka kwethu.
Ezimelweni eziqondile, siyakhuluma ngesihloko nomuthelezelo osemusha.
Siyasebenza ukuze sihlinze ingqalelo noma isibonelo.
Isifundo esisebenzayo esetshenziswa ukuze sibonise ukuvumelana.
Siyasebenza ukuze sihlinze ingqalelo noma umsebenzi ngendlela eqondile.
Siyasebenza ukuze sibonise ukuthi siyacabanga ngento ngaphambi kokuthatha isiqalo.
Oqondile nokuthula ukuze ubonise ukuba kukhona isimo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: In my view, the main issue is the budget for the project.
dialogue.translation: Ngokubuka kwami, umuthelezelo oqhubekayo ngoba yindlela yokusebenza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see your point, however, I think we should consider the timeline first.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyabona isibonelo sakho, nakuba, ngiyakholelwa ukuthi singacabanga ngesikhathi sokuqala.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is a valid point. Therefore, perhaps we can discuss both together.
dialogue.translation: Leyo ingqalelo eqondile. Ngakho, mhlawumbe singahlela ukudibhana ngokubili.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree with that. In addition, we could ask for more data from the team.
dialogue.translation: Ngivumelana nalokho. Ngaphambi kwalokho, singabiza imininingwane eminingi kulesiphi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea. According to the latest report, we have some flexibility.
dialogue.translation: Iqembu elihle. Ngokwemibono ka-acebo esisha, sinokuba nendlela yokusebenza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I suggest we prepare a proposal with both options.
dialogue.translation: Ngakho ngiphikisa ukuthi siqhubeke ukwenza umsebenzi ngokubili.

scenario: Describing a person's character in depth
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Isethwa ukudlulisela umuntu othi uqalile ngempela.
Umuntu othula ngokuphelele, angakeleki ukuba athole okuthile emva kwawo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I really admire my sister because she is always honest, even when it's difficult.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyamkela kakhulu udade wami ngenxa yokuthi uya ngamandla, nangisho lapho kunzima.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's great. My best friend is very brave – he once stood up to a bully at school.
dialogue.translation: Lokhu kuhle. Umngane wami omuhle kakhulu uyathwasa kakhulu – wami wabhekene nomphambayisa ekholisini.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wow, that takes courage. My sister is also generous and often helps our neighbors with their groceries.
dialogue.translation: Ewe, lokhu kude kakhulu. Udade wami njalo uyathula kakhulu futhi kanye njalo uyasiza abangelathi bakithi ngezinkathazo zabo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: She sounds kind. My friend is usually patient, but he can get into a bad mood if he's tired.
dialogue.translation: Uzakuba muntu omluze. Umngane wami ngokubanzi uyalinda, kodwa ungaba nomoya omubi uma ephuzekile.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. My sister is a bit shy at first, but once you know her, she's very friendly.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyabona. Udade wami uyathinte ngokuqala, kodwa uma umazi, uyakuba nomngane omuhle kakhulu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's nice. My friend has a great sense of humor – he always makes me laugh.
dialogue.translation: Lokhu kuhle. Umngane wami unezwi elihle lokuzwa ukuzwa – ngisho nje engingizwa ukukhona.

scenario: Talking about education and learning
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Isetshenziswa ukuze sithole ulwazi noma ubuchwepheshe.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to study more for my English course, but I don't have much time.
dialogue.translation: Kudingeka ngifunde banzi ikholisi lami lesiNgisi, kodwa angikhonzi isikhathi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Why don't you practice with me every evening? We can learn together.
dialogue.translation: Kungani uhlule ukudonsa nami ngamashumi amahlanu? Singafunda ngqo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I have a question: do you think our teacher will help us if we don't understand something?
dialogue.translation: Leyo inhloso enhle, kodwa ngin-ibuzo: uyakholelwa yini isifundisi esiyitholile siyakusiza uma singaqondi into ethile?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course, our teacher always answers every question with a clear example.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, isifundisi esiyitholile siphindisele ngaso sonke isibuzo nge-isibonelo esiqondile.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope I can remember all the new words we learn.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyakuthola ukuba ngikhumbula amazwi amasha onke esifundayo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: If you practice daily, you will see that you remember more easily.
dialogue.translation: Uma udonsa njalo, uyakubona ukuthi uyakhumbula ngokukhululekile.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's start today, and I'll be a better student!
dialogue.translation: Unelungelo. Masibuye namuhla, ngizoba yisifundo esihle!

key_phrases.phrase: Why don't you practice with me?

scenario: Discussing a problem and offering solutions
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Noma isetshenziswe kwilista lezinkomba, isetshenziswe lapha nendlela eyinye: 'agree on' (ukuvumelana ngenkinga).
Seyenziwa ukuze kwehlisele izincamiselo ngendlela ehloniphekile.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have a big problem with the schedule for next week.
dialogue.translation: Sinomlingo okhulu ngesikhashana lesivela.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I know it's hard, but maybe we can find a solution together.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyakwazi ukuthi kunzima, kodwa mhlawumbe singahletha isiphindo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd like to offer my idea: we could move the meeting to Friday.
dialogue.translation: Ngifisa ukuphikisa umbono wami: singahle ukususa ukubuye kusuza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds easy to do, but will everyone agree on the new time?
dialogue.translation: Kuyabona lula ukukwenza, kodwa ngabe wonke umuntu uyavumelana ngesikhathi esisha?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Let's ask them first, and then we can decide what to do.
dialogue.translation: Makasibuze kuqala, ngaleso sikhathi singachaza ukuthi siyakwenza njani.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good plan. Let's do that and solve this problem today.
dialogue.translation: Isicwaningo esihle. Makasikwenze futhi siphindise le mlingo namhlanje.

scenario: Comparing two options for a trip
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I can't decide which option to choose for our trip: the bus or the train.
dialogue.translation: Angikwazi ukubheka ukuthi ngikhethekani ngasihlobo setshalo lwethu: ibhesi noma itreni.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, the bus is cheaper than the train, but it's slower.
dialogue.translation: Kanti, ibhesi ilincane kunokuba itreni, kodwa ingokudlula.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the train costs more, and we need to arrive quickly.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, kodwa itreni iyingakwe ngokuningi, futhi siyidinga ukufika ngokushesha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Also, the train is safer, especially at night.
dialogue.translation: Nokho, itreni ilungile, ikakhulu ebusuku.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But the train is more expensive, and we can bring more luggage on the bus.
dialogue.translation: Kodwa itreni ingamahala kabanzi, futhi singathola amabheju amaningi ebesini.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true. So maybe we should take the bus and spend less money.
dialogue.translation: Lokho kunjalo. Ngakho-ke mhlawumbe singathamela ibhesi futhi sisebenzise imali encane.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's go with the bus. We can save money and still have fun.
dialogue.translation: Kulungile, masihambe nibeshi. Singahleka imali futhi singahle ngezingeni.

scenario: Talking about social media habits
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How often do you usually post on social media?
dialogue.translation: Ngubani ubuningi obuphawulayo kwezinqanaba zesoshiyali?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to share something every day, but sometimes I just scroll through my feed without posting.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyazama ukubananisisa into ngosuku, kodwa ngemarube ngihamba kuphambi kwe-feed yami ngaphandle kokuphawula.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow many people?
dialogue.translation: Uyalandela abantu abaningi na?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but I mostly follow friends and family. I don't like getting too many likes or comments, so I keep my profile private.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, kodwa ngilandela abangane nabangani. Angithandi ukuthola izithandwa nezinkombo ezinengi, ngakho ngiqhubeka isikhala sami esiphakeme.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's smart. I have a public profile because I want more people to see my posts.
dialogue.translation: Lokho kuhle. Ninesikhala esiphakeme ngoba ngithanda abantu abaningi ukubona izinkomba zami.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. But being online all the time can be exhausting, so I limit my time.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyakwazi. Kodwa ukuba phakathi ngesikhathi esinge sotshwala, ngakho ngiyachaza isikhathi sami.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Maybe I should do that too.
dialogue.translation: Uphuma. Mhlawum ngiyakwenza lokho nathi.

scenario: Giving a short presentation at work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's start. My presentation will include three main parts.
dialogue.translation: Kulungile, ake siqale. Ukuvula kwami luzofaka amagama amathathu amakhulu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds good. What is your first point?
dialogue.translation: Kulunga kangcono. Yini ipoyinti yakho yokuqala?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The first part is about our sales results from last month.
dialogue.translation: Isigaba sokuqala siyakutsho ngemiphumela yethu yokuthengisa njengenyanga edlule.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And what will you cover next?
dialogue.translation: Futhi uyozifihla njani ngoku?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Next, I'll talk about our main challenges during that period.
dialogue.translation: Ngokuqhubeka, ngizokhuluma ngemibuzo ethile ebalulekile ngaleso sikhathi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Will you also mention the new marketing strategy?
dialogue.translation: Uyakukhumbula noma isimo esisha sokuhweba?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's an important point, and I'll end with our goals for this month.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, leyiyipoyinti elibalulekile, ngizokwasekela ngemithetho yethu yale nyanga.

scenario: Discussing a sport or hobby you follow
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kulesi siqondo, landela isport noma ilayini, hhayi emakhasi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow any sport? I'm really into football.
dialogue.translation: Uyalandela yisiporotshi? Ngiyithanda kakhulu umgca wesokka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I watch basketball. My favorite team is the Lakers, although they don't win every match.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, ngibuka i-basketball. Ilayini lami elithandeka ngempela ngamaLakers, nakhu abayindi yonke into.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: They played against the Celtics last night, right? Who scored the most points?
dialogue.translation: Badlala phambi kwamaCeltics kusalku, yini? Ngubani owaphawule amaphuzu amaningi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, but we lost. Their best player had an amazing game.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, kodwa sahlasela. Umdlali wabo omuhle wayenengxoxo eyakhamisa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a shame. Do you think they have a chance in the playoffs this season?
dialogue.translation: Lokho kuxakaza. Ucabanga ukuthi banomuzuzuma kwiprayofi kulesi sikhathi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe, but it's hard. Although they have good players, they need to improve their defense.
dialogue.translation: Mhlawumbe, kodwa kunzima. Nakhu banomadolobheni abahle, kudingeka bophele umbono wabo.
